ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio estimated at 92:8 favoring high-intensity white pixels over low-intensity black perimeter pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitude of variations ranges from 4 to 20 pixels relative to the mean lobe arc.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge exhibits a primarily convex sweep from the median notch to the distal tips, with increased downward curvature at the outer lobe extremities.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular dark textural massing at both fluke tips, indicating localized physical trauma or dense barnacle colonization sites.
